target: section CommSemiring in Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Matrix/Nondegenerate.lean (`variable {m n R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] {M : Matrix m n R}`)
claim: The PR stops the generalization at `CommSemiring`, but commutativity (and even the unit and associativity) is needed only by the three transpose lemmas. `separatingRight_def`, `separatingLeft_def`, `nondegenerate_def` and the `Nondegenerate.eq_zero_of_ortho` / `exists_not_ortho_of_ne_zero` family (and their primed versions) hold at `NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring`, the generality the definitions `SeparatingLeft` / `SeparatingRight` / `Nondegenerate` already have after #39634. `separatingLeft_iff_forall_vecMul_eq_zero`, `separatingRight_iff_forall_mulVec_eq_zero`, `SeparatingLeft.eq_zero_of_vecMul_eq_zero`, `SeparatingRight.eq_zero_of_mulVec_eq_zero` and `nondegenerate_iff_forall_vecMul_and_mulVec_eq_zero` hold at `Semiring`. Only `separatingLeft_transpose_iff`, `separatingRight_transpose_iff` and `nondegenerate_transpose_iff` (with their aliases) need commutativity, and `NonUnitalCommSemiring` is enough for them, because `dotProduct_transpose_mulVec` is stated at that level.
requested_change: Split the new `section CommSemiring` by what each lemma needs, keeping the proofs as they are: (1) `section NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring` with `variable {m n R : Type*} [NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring R] {M : Matrix m n R}` holding `separatingRight_def`, `separatingLeft_def`, `nondegenerate_def` and then, under `variable [Fintype m] [Fintype n]`, `Nondegenerate.eq_zero_of_ortho`, `Nondegenerate.exists_not_ortho_of_ne_zero`, `Nondegenerate.eq_zero_of_ortho'` and `Nondegenerate.exists_not_ortho_of_ne_zero'`; (2) `section Semiring` with `[Semiring R]` holding the `vecMul`/`mulVec` characterisations (`separatingLeft_iff_forall_vecMul_eq_zero`, `separatingRight_iff_forall_mulVec_eq_zero`, `SeparatingLeft.eq_zero_of_vecMul_eq_zero`, `SeparatingRight.eq_zero_of_mulVec_eq_zero`, `nondegenerate_iff_forall_vecMul_and_mulVec_eq_zero`); (3) a final section with `[NonUnitalCommSemiring R]`, or `[CommSemiring R]` if you want to keep it simple, holding only the three `*_transpose_iff` lemmas and their aliases. Leave `section Determinant` at `CommRing` as it is.
